instruction: Open Thunderbird and create a new local mail folder named "Archive-2026" under "Local Folders".

verification.condition: Check that the files ~/.thunderbird/*/Mail/Local Folders/Archive-2026 and ~/.thunderbird/*/Mail/Local Folders/Archive-2026.msf exist.
verification.expected_result: A new local folder "Archive-2026" is created; both the mbox file (Archive-2026) and its index (Archive-2026.msf) are present in the Local Folders directory.
